steps.title: Application submitted
steps.markdownContent:
Your application for an NHC {applicationType} has been submitted.

Keep your reference number in case you need to contact the National Housing Corporation about your application.

## What happens next

NHC will check your application and may contact you if it needs more information.

If you qualify, NHC may put you on a waiting list until a rental home or house lot is available.

**National Housing Corporation**
“The Garden”
Country Road
St. Michael

Telephone: (246) 536-5300
Email: NHC.CustomerService@barbados.gov.bb
